description: This file contains functions for managing firmware upgrades and boot configuration for an ASRock device, including manipulating MTD partitions, setting upgrade flags, and preparing the system for recovery or new firmware installation.

methods.name: asrock_bootconfig_mangle
methods.description: Modifies the boot configuration in the MTD partition to set or clear upgrade flags based on the argument ('bootcheck' or 'sysupgrade').

methods.name: asrock_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade by setting the boot configuration and cleaning up specific ubi volumes.
